title: A Refined Classic
cardAlt: White shaker kitchen with a marble-look peninsula, glass pendant lights, brass hardware, tile backsplash and stainless range
heroAlt: White shaker kitchen with a marble-look peninsula, glass pendant lights, brass hardware, tile backsplash and stainless range
paragraphs: In need of a complete kitchen overhaul, this family’s kitchen called for a fresh start. A clean, crisp palette and a brighter, more open layout replaced the outdated space with a kitchen designed around everyday functionality, improved flow, and greater flexibility for the way the family lives.

The kitchen is finished in crisp white shaker cabinetry with brushed gold hardware, a light quartz countertop and a soft tile backsplash. A professional-style range sits under a stainless hood, with glass pendant lights over the peninsula and a tall, built-in pantry wall with a stainless refrigerator. Warm hardwood floors and unlacquered-look brass faucet details add warmth against the white.
